source: FA Vision AI Operating System Blueprint

rules.task: Reply to every new comment and message on WhatsApp, Marketplace, Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok as soon as it is seen, with a changing reply that has the price, HD real photos and the website link. Thank people who like or share with an @mention and ask them to follow. (Platforms don't show who viewed a post, and don't let a Page message people who only liked.)
Write a one-page buyer brief for Alexander (what they want, budget, area, history)
Build quotes for custom pieces
Give discounts or change any price

Bulk-buyer finder (🏢 Bulk buyers): AI suggests local, independent schools, churches, hotels, offices, hostels, event centres and restaurants in Accra/Tema/Kasoa (chains left out), each marked unverified until Alexander opens its public source; for the keepers it drafts a WhatsApp/email pitch + quote line. Stops when the quantity or price is empty (never guesses). Never sends: Copy / Open WhatsApp / Add to Leads only.

Post every hour from 7am to 9pm on Instagram, X and TikTok (rates in Hourly posting below: start 1 Instagram, 2 X, 1 TikTok an hour, raised step by step), each with fresh description, trending hashtags, music and a call to action, plus the daily plan, stories, reels and pages.

Share listings to Facebook groups and renew Marketplace listings, run like Jiji: strategy and hourly postings. Student desk & chair set (FAV-014) into 10 fresh groups every 3 hours. More suggestions to be added by only Alexander.
Email Alexander every day a report of posts, reach, enquiries and sales
Send a review request to every customer after delivery
Use a customer's photo, name or story in a post (needs their written consent)

Brand profile kit (🪪 Profile kit): AI writes profile rebuild plans, bios (within each platform's limit), highlights, pinned trio, banner brief, title audit, keyword clusters and pinned-comment funnel per brand and platform from that brand's own facts. A bio is saved to 🏷 Brands only when Alexander clicks Save to brand; no live account is ever changed.

Trend videos (🎬 card on the Boost tab): ready prompts for the 'miniature me cleans my profile' AI-video trend per brand. Alexander makes the video in his own AI video tool and adds it to the videos library; posting goes through the normal video rules. Max about 1 a week (AI-only content risks demonetisation).

⚡ Prime: one press runs every tab at once (Facebook/Marketplace, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube side by side + trends, leads, sales, SEO, ads, AI Fix), aiming for ~6 minutes. Optional waits are dropped, but at least 8–12 s between two posts/comments on the same account, daily caps unchanged, every step still passes its own rule here, and a network stops on any warning or security check.

🤖 AI Fix (Open items): one button fixes every open item it may, through the existing jobs: Fix all captions, TikTok captions, missing Marketplace listings, profile links/pins, SEO fixes; lead replies are only drafted (WhatsApp opens, Alexander sends). It copies Alexander's own past choices (approved rules, Don't list, price choices, approved texts, caption style). It never deletes, enters passwords/keys/2FA, pays or subscribes, messages customers, changes prices or security settings: those show as Needs you.
Answer order-status and product questions from the company brain
Offer a refund, free repair or replacement
Handle complaints, disputes, legal or privacy matters
Draft the invoice from the agreed quote
Send balance reminders on day 3, 7 and 14
Flag and fix website vs Marketplace price mismatches
Pay anyone, add a new supplier, or change MoMo / bank details

Sales dashboard (📊 Sales): read-only revenue, orders, average order and balances owed by channel and product from the Orders sheet. 'Record a sale' is typed by Alexander himself; the AI never records or changes a sale.
Open a job card and materials list once the deposit is confirmed
Raise purchase orders for materials
Quality and safety sign-off before dispatch
Draft the weekly artisan roster and job posts
Prepare the pay sheet (approved every time)
Hire, discipline or let anyone go

Brand name + logo on every post picture: every picture the autopilot posts (Facebook groups and Page, Instagram, X, TikTok, stories, reels, Marketplace, Post now, Post to all groups, hourly, seasonal, Profile relay) shows the brand it goes out as, with that brand's own contacts. Pictures that already show the same brand are kept; another brand's picture is never used (a clean product photo stamped with the right brand instead). No stamp → not posted, reason logged.

Answer group joining questions automatically, then carry on with the job: rules boxes ticked, honest short answers from the joining profile's own brand (what it sells, where it is, found via Facebook search, will follow the rules), only its public business contacts. Never passwords, ID numbers, bank/card/MoMo details, payments or invites: those groups are skipped and marked 'needs a manual answer' with the question shown. Every answer is logged; Test fills the questions but never submits.
